title: Japanese Sushi Cooking Class in Seattle (Includes 4-Course Meal)
includes: Full 4-course menu with spring rolls, sushi roll, noodles and dessert
This is a BYOB event. Guests are welcome to bring wine and beer to enjoy during the class (not included)
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
policies: This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into a welcoming Seattle kitchen and explore the fundamentals of Japanese-inspired cooking, hosted through Cozymeal. This hands-on workshop with an esteemed sushi chef guides you through a complete four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Spring rolls with peanut dipping sauce
- Sushi: Salmon avocado roll with wasabi mayo
- Main: Pan-fried Asian garlic noodles with soy, sesame oil and chili flakes
- Dessert: Matcha ice cream float topped with whipped cream

Learn sushi rice preparation, rolling techniques and balanced flavor pairing as you craft each course. With its small-group setting and step-by-step instruction, this class offers an intimate and flavorful journey into Japanese-inspired cuisine.
